thread:
maya: Heads-up — Dependabot flagged CVE-2025-2397 in js-yaml (transitive via config-parser). Affected variant: js-yaml < 4.0.0. It shows prototype-pollution patterns but exploitability looks low for our infra. Requesting temporary allowlist for staging pipelines while we triage. :eyes:
sec-bot: [automated] CVE-2025-2397 | js-yaml | prototype pollution | link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-2397 | severity: HIGH | exploit maturity: LOW-MEDIUM
ashwin: Can you confirm which services pull it in? is it direct or transitive?
maya: Transitive via runtime-config -> config-parser -> js-yaml@3.13.0. Only occurs when loading user-provided YAML (feature flagged). Production surfaces: admin-config ingestion and deploy pipelines.
Priya R.: quick repro in staging: 
```
2025-03-05T14:12:03Z config-loader ERROR Untrusted YAML processed without schema validation
TypeError: Cannot set property '__proto__' of #
    at parse (node_modules/js-yaml/index.js:123:15)
```
sec-eng: Thanks. Given transitive nature + no immediate patch on that path, we can approve a short-lived exception but require compensating controls: 1) disable user YAML ingest on prod (feature flag off) 2) route all admin-config uploads to private subnet + egress ACL to block external C2 3) enable request-level audit logging for the service and push to secure S3 prefix 4) rotate any service tokens with possible exposure and deny KMS-DECRYPT to that SA until patch applied.
Dave L.: duration? approvers?
sec-eng: Approve for 7 days max (168h) pending upstream patch or us bumping to js-yaml@4.x and validating. Approvers: @sec-eng, @infra-eng (for network ACLs), @ops-oncall (for deploy gating). Need an RFC in the ticket with mitigation checklist and verification steps. Add :lock: reaction when network controls are in place.
maya: I'll open ENG-4321 and attach the repro + audit plan. I'll flip the prod flag off in next 30m and post status.
Priya R.: added minimal input schema validation on staging (sanitizer rule) and turned on audit logs. pushing PR for review.
ashwin: I'll schedule the ACL change with infra; ETA 3 hours.
sec-eng: Good. Create the temporary allowlist request in the risk tracker and tag it `temp-exception/js-yaml/CVE-2025-2397`. After patching, we require test evidence and log review before removal of compensating controls. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: thanks all — will update thread with ticket link. :thumbsup:
